mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) indicates accommodative monetary policy, which lowers discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when FEDFUNDS is below 0.5%, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) exceeds 8.0%, it signals a deteriorating labor market, which typically leads to central bank intervention and increased economic uncertainty, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when UNRATE > 8.0%, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, which typically leads to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline from the previous month, or the Rank IC is below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of manufacturing slowdown (INDPRO < 95.0), the S&P 500 tends to underperform due to weak industrial activity, leading to negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when INDPRO < 95.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of housing starts (HOUST) indicates strong consumer confidence and economic activity, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when HOUST > 900, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 235.0, it signals accelerating inflation, which typically leads to tighter monetary policy and negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 55% of periods when CPIAUCSL > 235.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of real GDP (GDPC1) indicates robust economic expansion, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when GDPC1 > 17000.0, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) exceeds 135,000 (thousands), it signals a strong labor market, which typically leads to positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 55% of periods when PAYEMS > 135000, or the Rank IC falls below 0.02 over any 2-year rolling window.
